description: Fetch an image from a public URL and re-encode it smaller (WebP/AVIF/JPEG), optionally resizing to a target width. Returns the optimized image plus before/after byte sizes. Use this when an AI-generated or dropped-in asset (hero image, screenshot, illustration) is too large to ship.

format.description: Output format. webp = best browser support; avif = smallest; jpeg = universal.

image_url.description: Public URL of the source image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF/GIF).

quality.description: Encode quality 1-100 (80 is a good default).

width.description: Resize to this width in px, preserving aspect ratio. Omit to keep original size.

name: optimize_image
title: Optimize / convert an image for the web
